title: Claude Code v2.1.294
summary: What's changed Fixed prompt and agent hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block Improved how prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
body:
- Fixed prompt and agent hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block

- Improved how prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
